messages:
Marie C: FYI BrightLayer onboarding: staging SDK init (~25 nodes) seeing intermittent 429s during preflight. Happened right after we gave them a big worker bump. @Jordan P can you take a look? Logs show repeated POST /v1/preflight 429s.

Jordan P: On it. Can you paste a small sample of the client trace? Are they using ephemeral tokens per worker or reusing a single token?

Marie C: Sample log: 
```
client:init -> POST /v1/preflight 429
x-rw-ratelimit-limit: 200
x-rw-ratelimit-remaining: 0
token: ephemeral ttl=30s
```
They spawn a new worker per request in their serverless stack, so probably a fanout. :grimacing:

Jordan P: Sounds like a thundering-herd on preflight. Two quick customer-side mitigations: 1) splay init across workers / centralize token fetch; 2) reuse a single token for warmup or bump ephemeral TTL if possible. I'll run a quick sim.

Lekha I: @Jordan P also check if the edge sees this as a single API key with many concurrent preflights — that can trip our handshake concurrency guard. We can consider a short grace window for onboarding but prefer client fixes. Suggest doc-level guidance: "do not fetch token per worker; splay; add jittered backoff".

Jordan P: Repro'd locally: 50 parallel preflights in <1s -> consistent 429s. Proposed action items: - Share small splay+token-cache snippet they can drop in - Offer temporary staging IP allowance for a 5m warmup window (ops can flip) - Add a short KB note to onboarding playbook showing our observed headers (`x-rw-ratelimit-remaining`, `x-rw-ratelimit-reset`) and recommended backoff.

Marie C: Can you paste the snippet I can send to BrightLayer?

Jordan P: Sure — small example to send: 
```
// naive example: single token fetch + splay
let _cachedToken = null;
async function getRwToken() {
  if (_cachedToken) return _cachedToken;
  // tiny random splay before first token fetch
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.floor(Math.random()*300)));
  _cachedToken = await fetch('/my/token/endpoint');
  return _cachedToken;
}
```
Also note their client should honor `x-rw-ratelimit-reset` (we saw ~10s) before retrying aggressively.

deploy-bot: deploy: staging-rate-limit-patch rolled to prod at 2024-04-12T14:02:00Z :rocket:

Marie C: Thanks both — I'll send the snippet and ask them to try with token reuse + splay. I'll request they report back after one hour of warmup traffic. If still failing we can do the temporary ip whitelist.

Lekha I: I'll open a KB entry with the example and a suggested backoff policy (exp backoff + jitter + cap). Will tag @Marie for review.

Marie C: Closing when BrightLayer confirms. :thumbsup:
